17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1247 North California Avenue, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: © _RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 4,499.55 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to permit two (2) additional dwelling units
within the basement of the existing three-story six (6) dwelling unit
residential building for a total of eight (8) dwelling units. The height and
footprint of the existing building will remain without change. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location. The proposed residential building
will be supported by three (3) off-street parking spaces at the rear of the
subject property. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the off-
street parking ratio for a Transit Served Location to 37.5% (three (3) parking
spaces for eight (8) residential units) and is seeking all relief necessary, as
allowed by the code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 6,570 square feet (1.26 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 562.44 square feet per D.U.
(8 residential units)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is 4 designated Transit Served Location (Division Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the
required number of off-street parking spaces from 4 parking spaces (50%) to 3
parking spaces (37.5%).

@) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 8.21 feet (existing)
db. Side Setbacks:
North Side: zero (existing)
South Side: 6.4 feet (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 22.92 feet (existing)

(E) Building Height: 38 feet (existing)
